the board.Lock: the likeliest winner among picks worth their price (the engine's own read beats the price)
the board.Dog: a real-value dog the whole dog score likes best; score-picked dogs 2u max
the board.units: only when the read beats the real price (the money check): the Lock sized by its own read (quarter-Kelly, ½u-5u, a Lock needs 56%+), the Dog by its edge up to 5u, every value play 0.5u, moneyline only
the board.leans: who-wins calls, NO UNITS - ever (the owner, 10/2); no college favorite lean at -150..-130

dog gates (the whole dog score).NHL: 6+ (or the best hockey dog that beats its price)

weights on the read: hockey favorite: the line moved by the dog across the ice, the first 2 weeks, a tired opponent (3rd game in 4 nights), the other goalie in a save % slump
NFL West Coast road favorite in the East +2
the record correction never puts a side under the line
dog score points: last result / form / shots / hits / puck luck / rest (hockey; NBA and MLB: the Dog of the Day's screen)
NFL dog on a win streak
MLB doubleheader game 2 (the Dog of the Day's screen)
hockey sharp dog (line to it + money over tickets)
fades: ice cold, coach's first season (cancels if both new), losing streak, key player out, East home dog vs a West favorite, money running away
what the engine weighs now.early plays: every one that clears the bar, posted the moment it's found (checked every hour), no phone ping - it's on the dashboard, dogs +100..+350 only (dogs early, favorites on game day), the spots + believed leads + college rain / snow weighed, both teams' injury reports checked; 1u off a bye, ½u the other spots - never forced (the one-a-week minimum is paused)
what the engine weighs now.daily double check: every study's data loaded, every team's results in (a gap = no pick on that game), every pick checked against the rules before the board posts
